context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 242 fully tested. Three features: (1) OfficeWeekWidget on Dashboard - GET /api/resources-office-week returns {week_start, days:[{weekday, date, people[], count}]} with 5 days (Mo-Fr). Widget shows avatar stacks per day with +N badge for overflow. Today's column has green border. Privacy: hide_from_office_widget=true excludes user. Only confirmed bookings aggregated. (2) Ad-hoc Skip - GET /api/users/me/office-days/upcoming returns auto_generated bookings for next 28 days. DELETE /api/resource-bookings/{id} cancels booking. Profile page shows 'KOMMENDE BÜROTAGE' list with skip buttons (data-testid='office-day-skip-{booking_id}'). (3) Chat-Announce - PUT /api/users/me/office-days accepts announce_to_conversation_id. POST generate returns 'announced': true/false. System message with type='system', system_event='office_days_announce' posted to conversation. Failure-tolerant: invalid conv_id returns announced=false, not 500.
